value.rationale: A natural cyclic/symmetric fixed-point space on the central family of Hamming Vietoris–Rips complexes receives an infinite-parameter integral homotopy classification. Unlike the simply connected ambient radius-two complex, the fixed locus has an exponentially growing free fundamental group, and from m=3 has both circles and three-spheres. The natural augmentation symmetry module pinpoints the new homology classes, making the result a substantive sharp boundary classification rather than a mere substitution or reproduction of known cube Betti numbers.
